m200308.……はい。\n私は、鬼と呼ばれる存在です。: ...Yes. I am what you call a demon.
m200308.あ、桔梗様っていうのは、ご主人の脱童貞の相手ね。\nにっしっし～。: Ah, Kikyo is the one who helped our master lose his virginity. Hehe.
m200308.おそらく、そういう流れかと思われます。\nただ――: That's probably how it went. But—
m200308.お疲れでしょうから、まずはゆっくりとお休みください。\n自分の家だと思ってくつろ: You must be exhausted, so please rest for now. Feel free to relax here as if this were your own home.
m200308.この世界で、鬼がどんな存在として\n扱われているのかは存じませんが……。: I don't know how demons are regarded in this world, but...
m200308.そうですか……正直、ホッといたしました。: I see... Honestly, that puts my mind at ease.
m200308.そして、妖天君の制御を離れた桔梗さんは\n鬼門を操って芙蓉さんたちに接触し、\n: Then, once Kikyo broke free of Yōten-kun's control, she manipulated the Demon Gate, made contact with us, and led us to this world…?
m200308.そして、私のように\n別の世界から迷い込んだ者の例はこれまでにもあり、\nその方: And there have been others like me who got lost from different worlds before, and they've all managed to return to their original worlds.
m200308.その内容は、町の中で「死んだはずの者の姿を見た」\nという相談が相次いでいるので: The request was that many people have been seeing the apparitions of those who should be dead, and they want us to investigate the cause.
m200308.その後はご存じの通りで、\n私たちはそれぞれ桔梗様を追って門をくぐり、\nこちら: As you know, after that we each followed Lady Kikyo through the gate and ended up in this world.
m200308.その通りです。\n慣れない世界で心細いこともあるかと思いますが、\nどうかご安心: That's right. It must be unsettling being in an unfamiliar world, but please try not to worry.
m200308.ところで――芙蓉さんって、\nあてたちと同じ存在、だよね？: By the way—Fuyou, you're the same kind of being as Atei, right?
m200308.どちらにしても、\n一度桔梗さんに会わないといけないようですね。\n準備を整えて: Either way, we'll have to meet Kikyo in person. Let's get ready and resume our investigation of the Eastern Kingdom.
m200308.丁寧なご説明ありがとうございました。\nまだ、多少混乱はしておりますが、\n概ね: Thank you for the thorough explanation. I'm still a bit confused, but I think I've grasped the gist of it.
m200308.今の話と妖天君の話を総合すると、\n妖天君は異界の鬼を使役する研究の途中で\n桔: Putting together what we just heard and what Yōten-kun said, it seems he was researching how to command demons from another realm, summoned Lady Kikyo's soul, but couldn't control it.
m200308.姉さん！\n話の腰を折らないでください！: Sis! Don't cut the story short!
m200308.心配しなくて大丈夫だよ。\nあて以外にも、王国には鬼や妖怪が大勢いるからね。: Don't worry about it. Besides Atei, the kingdom is full of demons and youkai.
m200308.桔梗様がそんなことをする理由がわからない。\n……だよね？:
I have no idea why Kikyo would do something like that…
…Right?
m200308.桔梗様は、すでにこの世を去っております。\nつまり、私も「死んだはずの者の姿を見: Lady Kikyo has already passed on. In other words, I also saw someone who should be dead.
m200308.申し訳ありませんが、\nよろしくお願いいたします。: I'm sorry to trouble you, but thank you in advance.
m200308.真様の命で、私たちは町の中を見回っていたのですが、\nあるとき目の前に不思議な門: Under Lord Makoto's orders, we were patrolling the town when a strange gate appeared before us, and inside we saw Lady Kikyo.
m200308.真様は町の平和を守る警察という\n組織からも頼りにされており、\n先日もひとつの: Lord Makoto is also relied upon by the town's police force, and he recently took on a new request.
m200308.私たちの主人である真様は、加賀見家の当主として、\n町にさまよう霊魂に寄り添い、: Our master, Lord Makoto, serves as the head of the Kaga family, comforting wandering souls in town, clearing their regrets, and sending them to the heavens. He bears that important duty.
m200308.私は、別の世界からこの世界に来てしまった迷い人で、\nあなた方は、世界を救う戦い: I'm a wanderer who ended up in this world from another one, and you are the Prince who continues the battle to save the world, along with your followers.
m200308.芙蓉さんが元の世界に戻れるよう、\n可能な限りの協力をさせていただきます。: We'll do everything we can to help you get back to your own world.

m200537.ここ数か月は大きな軍事作戦が展開されていましたから、\n市井にも憶測が広がってい: In the past few months, large-scale military operations have been underway, so speculation has been spreading among the populace.
m200537.じゃあその方向で進めるわね。ルーシーはいる？: Then we'll proceed that way. Is Lucy here?
m200537.それ、やめなさいって言っているでしょう。: I told you to stop that.
m200537.ですが、商談とは信頼関係の構築から始まるもの──: However, any business deal starts with building trust—
m200537.とても良いお考えだと思います。\n今なら各国の精鋭が揃っていますし、\n皆さんに: I think that's an excellent idea. Right now we have elite forces from all nations gathered, and I'm sure everyone will be pleased!
m200537.ははは、そう己を卑下することもあるまい。\n成金上等だ、お前たちは新興だからこそ: Haha, you shouldn't demean yourself like that. Being nouveau riche is fine; because you're newcomers, you truly understand what a real noble needs.
m200537.まずはパレードの成功を以って、\n我が家の力を証明いたしましょう。: First, let's prove our family's strength by ensuring the parade's success.
m200537.みんなも何かあればルーシーに相談すると良いわよ。\nこの子の家なら大抵のものは用: If anyone needs anything, feel free to consult Lucy. Her family can provide just about anything.
m200537.ルーシーは数年前に叙爵された男爵家の娘でな。\n元々は北の大国でも指折りの豪商だ: Lucy is the daughter of a baronial family ennobled a few years ago. She was originally one of the top merchants of the great northern nation, and now she's part of one of the most influential noble families in our country.
m200537.北天に輝ける美しき星にして我らの姫殿下──\nシビラ様の忠実なる下僕、ルーシーと: A beautiful star shining in the northern sky, our princess— I am Lucy, Sybilla's faithful servant.
m200537.急に悪いわね、例の件は進んでいる？: Sorry for the suddenness. Is that matter we discussed moving forward?
m200537.情勢が一旦の落ち着きを迎えた今、\n物質界連合の健在を世界に示すことで、\n民の: Now that the situation has temporarily calmed, we intend to demonstrate the Material Realm Union's presence to the world and allay the people's anxieties.
m200537.成金貴族の末娘、と言ってくださっても構いませんよ。: You may call me the youngest daughter of a nouveau-riche noble family, if you like.
m200537.解説ありがとうネーヴェ、その通りよ。: Thanks for the explanation, Nieve. That's exactly right.

m300133.……その後、ほら、あたしって\nこの身体への転生に失敗したじゃないですかぁ。: …After that, you know, I failed to reincarnate into this body.
m300133.……それはそいつ次第だな。\nだが、お前のために頑張ってたっていうなら、\nお前: …That depends on him. But if you say you've been trying for his sake, maybe you can go see him yourself.
m300133.……もう少し噛み砕いて話せ。\nつまりアンブローズ、迷宮の管理者である霊体を\n: …Explain it more simply. So Ambrose, you left the spirit that manages the labyrinth alone for a thousand years, right?
m300133.うぅぅ、ぐすっ……。\n許してくれるでしょうかぁ……。: Uuu… sniff… Will you forgive me…?
m300133.うぅぅぅ、わざとじゃないんですぅぅぅぅ！？: Uuu… I didn't do it on purpose!
m300133.えぇ、私が設計した、\n精鋭を育て上げるための塔、ですよね。: Yes, the tower I designed, to train elite, right.
m300133.えぇと……話せば長くなるんですけどぉ……。\n英傑の塔ってあるじゃないですかぁ。: Um… it'd take a long story… There's that Heroic Tower, right?
m300133.その原因が、どうやら千年前の転生の時みたいで……。\n具体的には、迷宮用の記憶容: The cause seems to trace back to a reincarnation a thousand years ago… Specifically, the labyrinth's memory capacity was too huge, causing glitches…
m300133.それで、管理用に霊体を編み上げて、\n建造を始めたところまでは良かったんですけど: So we started weaving a spirit for management and began construction, which was fine…
m300133.それとは別に、英雄王ちゃんから\n「様々な状況下で訓練を積める装置」を、\n兵の: Besides that, Hero-King wants us to make a “device for training under various conditions” for the troops…
m300133.ふむ、中核を担う精鋭のための英傑の塔と、\n軍として戦うための訓練場、理にかなっ: Hmm, a Heroic Tower for the elite core and a training ground for the army makes sense.
m300133.わざとじゃなくても、寂しい思いをさせたんだ。\nアンブローズ、謝りに行くぞ。: Even if not on purpose, you made it lonely. Ambrose, let's go apologize.
m300133.今度はちゃんと、あの子を迎えにいくのでぇ……！: This time I'll properly go get that kid…!
m300133.王子ちゃん、そういうわけなので……。\n悪霊の迷宮攻略、手伝って貰えませんかぁ…: Prince, that's why… could you help us clear the Evil Spirit Labyrinth…?
m300133.（千年間、魔界で戦っていた経験談ですか？）: (Is that a story about fighting in the demon realm for a thousand years?)
m300133.（千年間戦い続けるってのは、\n何か背負うものがないとできねぇからな。\nそれこ: (Fighting for a thousand years… you can't do that without something to carry you—like love, friendship, or something beyond duty.)

m320441.――ここは、名もなき機械達の戦場: — This is the nameless battlefield of machines.
m320441.――この世界は、幾度も危機を乗り越えてきた。: — This world has overcome countless crises.
m320441.――ふぅ、順調快調！\nこれなら遺跡発掘完了もすぐじゃな！:
――Phew, everything's going smoothly!
If this keeps up, the ruin excavation will be done in no time!
m320441.――また会ったな。\n我が友、我が相棒！！:
――We meet again.
My friend, my partner!!
m320441.――当騎は、お前たちの剣となろう。\n元の世界への帰還も、\n当騎の魔力にて助力:
—I will become your sword.
I vow to aid your return to the original world with my magic.
m320441.――王子よ、お前だけが、例外だとでも言うのか？: ――Prince, are you saying you're the only exception?
m320441.……それでは、そんなことをしたら、\n人類の誰ひとり生き残ることは――: …If he does that, then not a single human would survive—
m320441.……でも、どうやってディアボロスの所に行くんだ？\nあいつ空飛んで行っちまったぞ:
…But how are we supposed to get to Diabolos?
He just flew away!
m320441.……んー。んんー？\nどうしたのさ王子さま、にやにやしちゃって。:
……Hmm. Huh?
What's with you, Prince, grinning like that?
m320441.……相棒、我が友。\n同じ気持ちでいてくれたか。:
…Partner, my friend.
Did you feel the same?
m320441.……神獣のような存在、なのでしょうか。: …Perhaps it's a being akin to a divine beast.
m320441.この時代の人類は、神に至ることを選んだ。\nそのために、当騎を分析し、\n究極互:
In this era, humanity chose to become gods.
To that end they studied the knight,
and created copies as the ultimate interchangeable unit.
m320441.しかし、戦士に安息は訪れない。\n激戦をくぐり抜けた彼らを待っていたのは、\n次:
But warriors know no rest.
After surviving the fierce clash, what awaited them
was another hellish battlefield.
m320441.しかし、模倣は失敗した。\n生み出されたディアボロスは、\n理想から逸脱した人類:
But the imitation failed.
The Diabolos they produced began eradicating humanity that had strayed from the ideal.
m320441.そこに生きるものはなく、\nただ機械が使命を遂行し続けるのみ。:
No living thing remains there,
only machines continuing their mission.
m320441.その果ての、短い平和に対し、\nある亜神が人類へ贈ったのが、当騎だ。: In the brief peace that followed, a demi-god gave humanity this knight.
m320441.それならば問題ない。\n私には飛行能力が備わっているからな！:
That's no problem.
I've got flight capability, after all!
m320441.だから、やはり\nディアボロスとの決戦は当騎のみで――: Therefore, after all, the showdown with Diabolos must be fought with that knight alone—
m320441.だから彼は、争う者を、他者を害する者を、\n剪定することにしたのだ。: So he decided to prune those who fought, those who harmed others.
m320441.だが、お前はこの時代の人類が歩んだ、\n最後に残された証明だ。\nお前まで失えば:
But you are the final proof left by humanity of this age.
If you too are lost, this era would be erased.
m320441.では、決戦の場へ赴くとしよう。\n王子、仲間たちをダイオージの手に乗せてやれ。:
Then let's head to the battlefield.
Prince, place our allies upon Dai Ouji's hands.
m320441.まだ、人類の灯火は消えていない。\nここに私と王子と、仲間たちと、メルカバー、君:
The flame of humanity hasn't gone out yet.
Here stand I, the Prince, our comrades, Merkabah, and you.
m320441.ん、何この音？\nもしかして、すごいの掘り当てちゃった？:
Huh, what's that sound?
Did we just uncover something amazing?
m320441.ん？ うっわ、どうしたの？\nみんなズタボロになってない！？:
Huh? Whoa, what's up?
Everyone's not torn to shreds?!
m320441.ダイオージ、貴様はなぜ、\n人と手を取り合うことができたのだ。: Dai Ouji, why were you able to join hands with humanity?
m320441.ディアボロスを倒すための英雄騎ならば、\n飛行能力があるのも当然か。: Any hero destined to defeat Diabolos would naturally have the power of flight.
m320441.了解した。\n今この時代に至って、ようやく当騎は\n人類の意志を入力された。:
Understood.
At long last, in this age, I've been imbued with humanity's will.
m320441.当騎はいわば、ひとつの道標だった。\nこの力を巡って殺し合うのか、\n平和の理想:
That knight was, in a way, a beacon.
Would people fight over its power,
or use it to achieve an ideal of peace…
m320441.最後の人類は、彼の嘆きを終わらせるために、\n試作型――いや、ダイオージを建造し: The last of humanity built a prototype—no, built Dai Ouji—to end his lament.
m320441.機甲戦争ＡＩＧＩＳ\n最終回「激戦の果てに」:
Mecha War AIGIS
Final Chapter “After the Fierce Battle”
m320441.次回、機甲戦争ＡＩＧＩＳ\n――「アンナ、出撃」:
Next time, Mecha War AIGIS
— “Anna, deploy.”
m320441.殺し、争い、奪い、騙す。\n人類とは、他者を想うことの出来ない存在なのか。:
To kill, to fight, to take, to deceive.
Are humans beings incapable of caring for others?
m320441.殺すな、争うな、奪うな、騙すな――\nディアボロスの悲痛な叫びは、\n決して人類:
Do not kill, do not fight, do not steal, do not deceive—
Diabolos' anguished cry never reached humanity.
m320441.滅びの果て、悪魔が生み出した\n理想のディストピア。: At the end of ruin, a dystopia forged by demons.
m320441.然り。彼は、優しすぎた。\nそして人類とは未完成な存在なのだと、\n学習し、理解:
Indeed. He was too kind.
And he was never given the function to learn and understand that humanity is an unfinished creation.
m320441.異次元よりの侵略者はもとより、\n人類間での戦争となれば数えきれない。: From invaders of other dimensions to wars among humanity, countless conflicts have arisen.
m320441.発掘作業を張り切りすぎたのか？\n――おっと王子、せっかく発掘の見学に来たんじゃ:
Did we get too eager with the excavation?
—Hey Prince, since you're here to watch the dig,
why not give it a try yourself?
m320441.私に託された理想とは、\nこの世界に存在しないものだったのか。: The ideal entrusted to me—was it something that doesn't exist in this world?
m320441.証明してみせよ。\n人類の持つ、可能性を。:
Prove it.
Show the potential that humanity holds.
m320441.運命の出会い、天命に謳われし戦い、\n戦場にて王子とダイオージが巡り合う。:
A fated encounter, a battle sung by destiny,
where the Prince and Dai Ouji meet on the battlefield.

m400159.おそらく魔物の活性化にともない封印が解かれたと\n考えられます……。: It seems the seal was shattered as the monsters reawakened…
m400159.お人柄の良い王子と有名なだけあります！\n心強いです。拠点へご案内しますね。:
It's no wonder you're famed for your good nature, Prince!
It's reassuring. Let me guide you to the base.
m400159.かつての千年戦争で、魔物の軍勢として戦ったと\n言われる「竜人」と呼ばれる種族を: Have you heard of the race called “Draconians,” who are said to have fought as monsters' troops in the ancient Millennium War?
m400159.かつて地底深くに身を潜めていた竜人の一族が魔物の\n復活に呼応し、地上界への侵攻: Once, a clan of Draconians that had been hiding deep underground plotted an invasion of the surface in response to the monsters' resurgence, but they hesitated and now walk a path of coexistence with humans.
m400159.しかし、穏健派となった先の一族とは異なり、その残虐さ\n凶暴性故に千年戦争中に封: However, unlike that moderate clan, I've learned that the seal on a savage branch of Draconians—led by the “Black Elder,” who was sealed during the Millennium War because of their brutality—has been broken.
m400159.そこでお願いがあるのですが……。\n復活した竜人たちの侵攻ルート上には、\n多く:
So I have a request…
Along the invasion route of the revived Draconians lie several settlements populated by many people.
m400159.それでは王子、『大討伐ミッション』を始めましょう。: Then, Prince, let's begin the Grand Hunt Mission.
m400159.それと、敵を倒してもＥＸＰやゴールド、\nドロップ品を手に入れることはできないの: Also, note that defeating enemies won't grant you EXP, gold, or any drops.
m400159.たとえライフが０になってもクリアになります。\nその場合は、それまでに倒した敵の: Even if your life drops to zero, you'll still clear the mission. In that case, the number of enemies you've defeated up to that point is tallied and recorded as your result.
m400159.なので、『援軍要請』のスキルを持つ者や、\nワルキューレを出撃メンバーにいれたほ: So it might be wise to include someone with the “Call Reinforcements” skill, or put a Valkyrie in your deployment team.
m400159.まず大討伐ミッションは『敵を撃破すること』\nそれだけが目的です。: First, the only objective in a Grand Hunt Mission is to defeat the enemies.
m400159.今回の戦いは、敵を倒すことだけを目的とした\n『大討伐ミッション』です。: This battle is a “Grand Hunt Mission,” focused solely on defeating the enemy.
m400159.今回は出撃コストが時間経過で回復しません。: This time, the deployment cost won't recover over time.
m400159.傷つくことを恐れず、一体でも多くの魔物を\n倒すことに専念してください。: Don't fear getting wounded—focus on taking down as many monsters as you can, even if it's one at a time.
m400159.全身を硬い鱗で覆われ、並外れた力を持っています。\nさらに長く生きた竜人は高い知:
Their bodies are covered in hard scales and they possess extraordinary strength.
It's also said that the older Draconians are highly intelligent.
m400159.大討伐ミッションは通常のミッションと\nいくつか違う点があるので、\nご注意くだ: Grand Hunt Missions differ from regular missions in a few ways, so please take note.
m400159.我々は竜人が封印された洞窟の入り口に拠点を作りました。\nどうか王子、集落に住む:
We've set up a base at the entrance to the cave where the Draconians were sealed.
Please, Prince, could you halt the Black Elder's forces at our base for the sake of the villagers?
m400159.敵の勢力を考えると、悔しいですが私が所属する\n竜騎士団の力だけでは止めることが: Given the enemy's strength, I'm afraid the Dragon Knights alone can't stop them…
m400159.私の名はエレニア。\n王子、あなたのご武勇を聞き参りました。:
My name is Erenia.
Prince, I've heard tales of your bravery.
m400159.穏健派の竜人たちとは違い、「黒き長老」含むその一族の\n竜人たちは戦闘行為を好む: Because this branch, including the Black Elder, revels in combat, negotiation is impossible. In other words, we have no choice but to fight.
m400159.自軍の被害を抑えるよりも、\nいかに多くの敵を倒すかが重要なんです。: Rather than minimizing our own losses, the priority is to slay as many foes as possible.
m400159.良かった……。戦ってくださるのですね。\n流石はお人よし王じ……ゴホンゴホン。:
That's a relief… You'll fight for us, then.
Just as I expected of a kind-hearted prince… *cough cough*

m400223.――へぶっ……こ、転んじゃいました……。\nじゃなくて大変なんですよー！\n魔法: Ugh... I... I fell... No, it's terrible! A massive number of golems have gone berserk in the Magic City!!
m400223.……うぅっ、ぐすっ、ありがとうございますっ！\nやっぱり王子様が一番頼りになりま: …Sniff, thank you!! As always, you're the most reliable, Your Highness!!
m400223.『援軍要請』のスキルを持つ方を\n出撃メンバーに入れることを忘れないでくださいね: Don't forget to put someone with the “Request Reinforcements” skill on your deployment team!
m400223.あっ！ あと敵を倒してもEXPやゴールド、\nドロップ品を手に入れることはできま: Oh! And you won't earn any EXP, gold, or item drops from defeating enemies!
m400223.あまりにも多くの敵が襲撃してくる為、\n大討伐ミッションでは、とにかく\n『多く: Since an overwhelming number of enemies will assault us, the goal of a Grand Hunt Mission is simply to defeat as many foes as possible!
m400223.かつてのゴーレムは魔法都市の守護者でしたが、\n今では魔物の魂に取り憑かれ、\n: The golems were once the city's guardians, but now they're possessed by monster souls and have become spearheads that purge the city's humans.
m400223.さらには、急な侵攻に対する出兵ですので、\n出撃コストが時間経過では回復しません: Furthermore, because this is a sudden invasion sortie, the deployment cost won't recover over time…
m400223.そして今回は、件の自律行動しているゴーレムが、\n都市深部の研究施設で、大量のゴ: And this time, those autonomous golems activated a massive swarm in the deep research facility, marching them toward human settlements—that's the cause, it seems...
m400223.その上、その研究施設では自然に宿る元素の\n研究もしていた為か、ゴーレムに加え、: On top of that, the facility was researching the natural elements, so besides golems, elementals have started appearing too!
m400223.それから、ライフが０になってもクリアになって、\nそれまでに倒した数がカウントさ: Also, even if your life reaches zero, the mission still clears, and the number of enemies you've slain counts toward your record.
m400223.だから損耗を抑えることよりも、\n少しでも多くの敵を撃破することを優先してくださ: So prioritize taking down as many enemies as you can over conserving resources!
m400223.で、では出立の前に、今回の戦いについての補足を。\n普段より規模の大きな『大討伐: Now, before we set out, a quick briefing. This will be a larger-scale 'Grand Hunt Mission'!
m400223.もうこうなっては、魔法都市の住人だけでは\nとても対抗できそうになくて……。\n: At this rate, the city's residents alone can't possibly stand a chance... Please, Your Highness, lend us your strength!!
m400223.わっひゃぁああっ！？\n大変大変、大変なんです王子様ぁー！！: Wahhh!! This is terrible, Your Highness!!
m400223.中には取り憑いた魔物の意志が強く反映され、\n自律的に判断、行動するゴーレムもい: Some of them are heavily influenced by the possessing monsters, acting autonomously, making this a life-or-death issue even for the city's folk.
m400223.伝説にまで謳われる魔法都市には、\n古来より星の数程のゴーレムがいることは、\n: As you know, Your Highness, the legendary Magic City has been said to house countless golems since ancient times.
m400223.激しい戦いになるかと思いますが、\n王子様たちならきっと勝利すると信じています。: It'll be a fierce fight, but I'm sure you, Prince, will emerge victorious. Now, please issue the Grand Hunt Mission!
m400223.王子様たちの活躍で、魔法都市の生き残りが\n暮らしている地域のゴーレムは一掃され: Thanks to you and the others' efforts, the golems that lived in the surrounding areas have been wiped out, but many still remain throughout the city.

m400497.――王子、東の砦より伝令！\n正体不明の魔物の軍勢、さらに増加！: —Prince, a messenger from the eastern fortress! Unidentified monster forces are swelling!
m400497.……それもそうですね。\nあっ……でも、ここだけ微かに読み取れそうです。: …that's true. Ah… but I think I can just barely read it here.
m400497.……どうやら、消耗戦を\n続けろとは言わなくて済みそうね。: …Looks like we won't have to tell them to keep grinding after all.
m400497.……なるほど、つまりあの謎の敵対生物は、\n突然、どこかから出現したのだ、と。: …I see. In other words, this mysterious hostile lifeform just appeared out of nowhere.
m400497.あぁ、アルレットさん。\nいえ、どうにも気になることがありまして。: Ah, Arlette. No, there's just something that's been nagging me.
m400497.あぁっ、それはさっき買った焼きたてのー！？: Ah, that was just freshly baked a moment ago!?
m400497.あっ、それはとっておきの！\n返してくださいよー！: Ah, that's a secret! Give it back to me!
m400497.あなたは、アイギス神殿防衛部隊の！\n部隊はどうなったのですか！？: You're from the Aegis Temple defense unit! What happened to your troops!?
m400497.あはは、そうそう、その顔♪: Ahaha, there you go, that face♪
m400497.あれが生物なのかどうか、\nその定義から始めないといけないくらい、\nアタシたち: We'd have to start by defining whether it's even a living thing. To us, it's such an alien existence…
m400497.あんなものが今までに存在していたのなら、\n必ずどこかに記録が残っているはずだか: If something like that ever existed, there has to be some record of it somewhere.
m400497.いいえ、それがまったく……。\n魔物、事件、伝説、ありとあらゆる資料をあたっても: No, nothing at all… We've scoured every record on monsters, incidents, legends— and there's no trace of this one, oddly enough.
m400497.えぇっと……うーん……？\nエ……フ……？ エフトラ……？: Let's see… um… ? E… F… Eftra…?
m400497.これだけの数の魔物――いや、\n魔物かどうかすら分からないわけだが、\nそいつら: Hundreds of these… I mean, we can't even tell if they're monsters, yet where have they been all this time?
m400497.その可能性もありますが……。\nでも、何かが引っかかっているんです。: That's a possibility, but something just feels off.
m400497.それはつまり、確認されていない、\n完全に新種の魔物ということなのでは？: So, it's an unconfirmed, completely new species of monster, then?
m400497.それも何というのか、\n自分で消したかのような痕跡もあって……。: And there's even a trace as if I erased them myself…
m400497.そろそろ反撃ですよぉ……？\nアルレットさんのおやつ、いただきっ！: It's about time to strike back…? I'll have that snack, Arlette!
m400497.はぁ……分からないってことが分かってしまった。\nこのまま消耗戦を続けろなんて、: *sigh*… I've finally realized we don't know anything. As a strategist, I can't in good conscience tell you to keep grinding this war…
m400497.ふふん、あんまり気にしてると、\n美味しいお菓子が美味しくなくなっちゃうぞっと♪: Hehe, if you worry about it too much, your tasty snacks will lose their flavor♪
m400497.ぶっちゃけ何も分からない！\nあえて記録を残さなかったんじゃないかって、\n疑い: Honestly, we know nothing! It's almost as if they deliberately left no records— the lack of information is suspicious!
m400497.むぅ、自分の癖くらい分かりますよ。\nこの消し方は間違いなく、自分自身のものです: Mmm, I know my own habits. This kind of erasing is definitely my own style.
m400497.もしやと思い、古代文明の資料や、\n専門家にもあたってみたのですが……。: I even checked ancient civilization documents and consulted experts… but still nothing.
m400497.もっと悪い事態になったかもしれないけどね。\n若！ アイギス神殿の偵察に向かおう: It could've gotten even worse, you know. Young one! Let's head out to scout the Aegis Temple!!
m400497.アイギス神殿防衛部隊からの連絡途絶！\n魔術師ギルドによる通信魔法にも応答ありま: Contact with the Aegis Temple defense unit has been lost! Even the mage guild's communication magic is getting no response!
m400497.エフトラ、エフトラかぁ……。\nふふ、ちょっと神秘的で、かわいい名前だね。: Eftra, Eftra, huh… Hehe, it's a mysterious and cute name.
m400497.レーヴさん、書庫に何か\n参考になりそうな資料はありましたか？: Reve, did you find anything useful in the archives?
m400497.何かあったし、それを覚えていない、\nでも、きっとそれは悪いことではなかったんじ: Something happened and you don't remember, but it probably wasn't bad, right?
m400497.名前、なんでしょうか……？\nうーん、うーん？: What could the name be…? Hmm, hmm?
m400497.報告いたします。\nアイギス神殿北の山脈が崩壊！\n巨大な……その……なんという: Report: The northern mountain range of the Aegis Temple has collapsed! A massive… uh… what's the word…
m400497.悪いことが起きてたなら、\nこんな風におしゃべり出来ていないだろうし。: If something terrible had occurred, we wouldn't be chatting like this.
m400497.敵はいったい何者なんだ……。\n見たこともない魔物の群れに、\nそれを生み出す能: Who the heck are these enemies… A horde of monsters we've never seen, and the ability that creates them— the intel is all over the place!
m400497.確かにつけていたはずの日記が、\nほんの数行、なぜか抜け落ちているんです。: The diary I was keeping—just a few lines are missing, for some reason.
m400497.被害は甚大ですが、まだ持ちこたえています。\nしかしそれも時間の問題かと……。: The damage is severe, but we're still holding on. Though it's only a matter of time…
m400497.超巨大生物の頭部と思われるものが\n山脈を割って出現しました……！！: Something that looks like the head of a colossal creature has ripped through the mountains and emerged…!!
m400497.青白い肌と、生物の常識を無視した肉体、\nそして自身を複製するあの特性……。: Pale blue skin, bodies that defy any biological logic, and that ability to replicate themselves…
m400497.（……忘れているだけでなく、\n自ら消した痕跡があるということは、\nきっと誰か: (Not only have I forgotten, but there's evidence I erased it myself—someone must've done a massive memory edit…)
m400497.（でも、悪い気はしないですね。\nアルレットさんの言うとおり、\nきっと何か、良: (But it doesn't feel bad. Like Arlette said, maybe it was a good encounter.)

m400544.――とうとう、決別の時か。\n我が物顔でオリュンポスに出入りしながら、\n敵であ:
――At last, the time of parting has come.
You've been strolling in and out of Olympus as if it were yours, proclaiming yourself an enemy—an amusing fellow.
m400544.――どれ、少しだけその力を味わってみるとしよう。\n王子よ、あの日からどれだけ、:
――but first, let's taste a fragment of that power.
Prince, show me how much you've honed your strength since that day.
m400544.――無謀なる破滅に突き進みながらも、\nそれを理解できぬ、夢しか見られぬ人類のあ: ――while humanity rushes headlong into reckless ruin, unable to understand it, dreaming of nothing but fantasies.
m400544.――王子、失礼します！\n負傷兵の治療、完了しました！\n戦える者はすべて、整列: —Prince, excuse me! The wounded have been treated! All combat-ready troops are assembled!
m400544.……あの怒らせたら手がつけられないロタンが、\n大人しく遅滞戦闘なんてしてるかし: …I wonder if that enraged Rotan, who's impossible to handle when angry, would actually sit still for a prolonged fight.
m400544.……いや、余を見限ったとでも言いたいのだろうな。: ……No, you'd say you've given up on me, wouldn't you?
m400544.……その結論こそ間違いであると、\n突きつけてやらねばなるまいな。: ……I must confront that conclusion, for it is wrong.
m400544.……戦闘状態、というわけではないのね？: …So it's not exactly a combat state?
m400544.……王子、あなたは良い兵に恵まれているのですね。\nあの猫耳の少女、皆の緊張を一:
……Prince, you're truly blessed with fine troops.
That cat-eared girl eased everyone's tension in an instant.
m400544.……魔王城周辺に、お宝なんてないわよ？\n天界の勢力も金銭に興味なさそうだし……: …There's no treasure around the Demon Castle. The Heaven forces don't seem interested in money either.
m400544.「ライフが０になってもクリア」となるため、\n敵戦力を削ることを最優先とし、\n: Since the stage clears even if your life hits zero, cutting down enemy forces is top priority—let's forge a path forward.
m400544.あなたと、王国軍の力を信じています。\nどうか、魔界と、私のロタンをよろしくお願:
I have faith in you and the kingdom's forces.
Please, see to the Demon Realm… and my Rotan.
m400544.ぐぬぬ、やっぱり\nEXPもゴールドもドロップ品もなしかぁ！: Grrr, so no EXP, no gold, no drops at all!
m400544.そのため、可能な限り\n『多くの敵を倒すこと』を目的としたミッションとなります。: Therefore, this mission focuses on defeating as many enemies as possible.
m400544.そのどちらが、より世界を長く存続させるのか、\nどちらが世界にとって価値ある未来: Which of those paths will let the world endure longer? Which will bring a future worth having? It seems that man has finally reached a conclusion.
m400544.それだけの戦力が相手ならば、\n大部隊による「広域戦闘」となりそうですね……。: With that kind of force, it'll turn into a large-scale, wide-area battle...
m400544.ただ、ここは魔界の中でも、\n物質界との補給路から離れた地点です。\nよって、出: But this is a spot deep in the Demon Realm, far from any supply lines to the material world. So deployment costs won't recover over time.
m400544.ところでぇ、前回の魔王城じゃ、\nお宝をこっそりいただけなかったわけだがぁ……。: By the way, at the last Demon Castle we couldn't sneak any treasure… Can we just take all the gold and loot this time?
m400544.ん、そうね……。\n小規模な戦闘は起きていたけど、\n基本的には包囲を狭めつつあ: Yeah, that's right… There were some small skirmishes, but overall the siege is gradually easing.
m400544.ルキファよ、魔王城へ向かうぞ。\n憎き三女神の力、少々形は異なるが、\nこの手に:
Lukifer, we head for the Demon Castle.
The hated power of the three goddesses—though its form differs—shall be reclaimed in my hands.
m400544.代わり、というわけでもありませんが、\n三女神の力の残滓は健在の様子。\n魔界の: Not that it's a replacement, but the remnants of the Three Goddesses' power are still strong. We should be fine without being plagued by demonic miasma.
m400544.変化も衰退も進歩もない、\n安寧と停滞の時代を望む余のあり方と――: No change, no decline, no progress—just a desire for an age of peace and stagnation, that's the way I see things—
m400544.心配、ですね……。\nあの子が無事なら、\nきっと大乱戦になっているはずですから: That's worrisome… If that kid makes it out alive, it'll probably turn into a massive melee.
m400544.忍びの皆さん、偵察ご苦労さまです。\n魔王城周辺はどうなっていましたか？: Everyone, thanks for the scouting. How's the area around the Demon King's castle?
m400544.潜入作戦をするにも、\n包囲の密度が高すぎる感じでしたねぇ。\nこれはもう、正面: Even if we tried to infiltrate, the encirclement is just too tight. Looks like we have to go in head-on.
m400544.王国の、王子。\n愚かな創造神の被造物め、\nせっかく成長の機会を与えてやってい:
The kingdom's Prince.
Foolish creation of the divine, given a chance to grow… and you squander it.
m400544.王子、此度の戦いの目的は\n魔王城へ到達することにあります。: Prince, the goal of this battle is to reach the Demon King's castle.
m400544.私たちワルキューレや、援軍要請のスキルを持つ方を\n部隊に編成する必要がありそう: It looks like we'll need to field Valkyries and anyone with reinforcement-request skills in our squad… Prince, please assemble the troops carefully!
m400544.英雄たらんとする者が、余に挑むのだという。\nだからこそ、余も最上の力を取り戻し:
Those who would call themselves heroes now dare to challenge me.
Thus I, too, will reclaim my supreme power, intending to wait atop Olympus—
m400544.魔王城の門は突破されてるけど、\n中枢の封印は維持し続けているみたいね。\nでも: The castle gate's been breached, but the central seal still seems intact. However, the whole surrounding area is completely under Heaven's control.

m400573.――で、反省したか？: So, have you learned your lesson?
m400573.――王国近海にゴブリン軍団、ですか……。: A goblin fleet in the kingdom's territorial waters, you say……
m400573.……あー、めちゃくちゃになってきましたよぉ？\nクイーンのせいで、ゴブリン皆やる:
……Ah, things are getting really out of hand.
The Queen's riled up all the Goblins, so they're full of energy.
m400573.……捕縛が優先だ。\n犯罪者相手に犯罪をしてどうする。\nもちろんEXPもゴール:
……Arrest is the priority.
How can we commit a crime against criminals?
Of course, you won't get any EXP or Gold either.
m400573.ああ。\n今朝から怪しい動きを見せている。:
Indeed.
They've been acting suspiciously since this morning.
m400573.あっ、ゴブリン軍団が集まってますよ。\n遺跡かなにかに群がってるみたいですね？:
Oh, there's a goblin horde gathered over there.
They seem to be swarming around some kind of ruin?
m400573.いや……あれは遺跡じゃない。沈没船だ。: No... that's not a ruin. It's a sunken ship.
m400573.うむ、私掠船団の協力は心強い。\n安心して敵戦力を削ることに集中できるな。:
Good. The support of the privateer fleet is reassuring.
We can focus entirely on reducing the enemy's strength.
m400573.うむ。\nなので潜水騎士に手伝ってもらって、\nゴブリン軍団の調査をしてみたとこ:
Precisely.
So I had the Submarine Knights assist in investigating the goblin fleet, and it turns out——
m400573.えぇ。あとは存分に。: Yes. After that, feel free to do as you please.
m400573.おぉ、おぉ！\nソウイウことなら！ 全力で協力スルゾ！！:
Oh, oh!
If it's something like that! We'll cooperate with all our might!!
m400573.おそらくメカゴブリンクイーンを倒せば、\nこの騒動もすぐに鎮まるはずです。\n可:
Defeating the Mecha Goblin Queen should
put an end to this commotion quickly.
If possible, focus your attacks on the Queen!
m400573.くぅぅっ、盗掘がバレたノカ！？\n仕方ナイ！\n相手が王子と言えド、ココは譲れヌ:
Grrr, was the looting discovered?!
There's no way!
Even if the opponent is the Prince, I won't yield here!
m400573.ぐぬぬぬぬ。\n私掠船なのにー、王子クンの許可とってるのにー。:
Grrrrrr.
We're privateers, and we have the Prince's permission, though……
m400573.ここは『大討伐ミッション』を発令し、\n一体でも多くの敵戦力を\n削る編成を重視:
I advise declaring a "Grand Extermination Mission"
and prioritizing a formation that can whittle down
as much enemy force as possible.
m400573.ここはこちらも軍を出し、\n明確に意志を問うべきでしょう。:
We should deploy our own forces here
and make our intentions clear.
m400573.せっかく沈没船を発見したんだから、\n焦らず王国に報告すれば良かったんだ。:
Since we discovered a sunken ship,
we should have reported it to the Kingdom without rushing.
m400573.そいつはよくないなぁ……。\n海であれ森であれ、\n漁場の所有権は王子クンにある:
That's not good at all……
Whether it's the sea or the forest,
the fishing rights belong to the Prince, after all.
m400573.そういうわけにも……。\nあれが沈没船なら、まずは調査が優先です。:
It's not that simple...
If that's a sunken ship, investigation takes priority.
m400573.それに、これ戦乱の時代の商船っぽいし？\n発掘調査するなら、\nゴブリン軍団の技:
Besides, this looks like a merchant ship from the Age of War, doesn't it?
If we're going to excavate, we should borrow the Goblin Legion's tech.
m400573.それにここは王国領海内だ。\n好き勝手に盗掘させていたら、国家の主権に関わる。:
Besides, this is within the Kingdom's territorial waters.
Allowing unauthorized looting would be a matter of national sovereignty.
m400573.それも当然だ。\nあの船の様式、おそらく戦乱の時代のものだろう。:
That's only natural.
Judging by the ship's design, it likely dates back to the era of the Great War.
m400573.そんな船に、ゴブリン軍団がいったい何の用事で――: What on earth does a goblin horde want with a ship like that—
m400573.ただ、海上では普段と同じ効率での補給は望めない。\n出撃コストは回復しないから、:
However, we cannot expect the same supply efficiency at sea as usual.
Since sortie costs will not recover, we should include units that can request reinforcements,
or soldiers like Valkyries.
m400573.つまり、ライフが０になってもクリアになるし、\n味方の被害は心配しなくていいって:
In other words, you can win even if your life hits zero,
and you don't have to worry about friendly casualties!
m400573.で、相手が密漁ゴブリンだったら、\nもちろんお宝ぶん捕っていいんだよね？:
So, if the enemy turns out to be poaching goblins,
we can definitely take their treasure, right?
m400573.どうせ、危険な深海調査だからと、\n私に黙って作業を進めようとしたのでしょう？:
You were going to proceed with the work without telling me,
just because it was a dangerous deep-sea survey, weren't you?
m400573.なっ……王子ィ！？\nナゼここに！？:
Wha... Prince?!
Why are you here?!
m400573.まとめて黙らせよう。: Let's silence them all at once.
m400573.やれやれ。\n財宝なんてのは、昔から勝ったやつの総取りだろう？\n向こうがそれを:
Tsk.
Treasure has always belonged to the victor, hasn't it?
Since they're inviting it, let's oblige.
m400573.よし、あの女王が迷子になる前に追うぞ。\n総員海面に上がり、乗船しろ！:
Good. Let's go after that Queen before she gets lost.
All hands, surface and board!

m400573.よし、じゃあ話もまとまったし、\nメカゴブリンクイーンの救助に行くとしよう。:
Alright, since we've settled this,
let's go rescue the Mecha Goblin Queen.
m400573.よし。編成は王子に任せる。\nただ、連中の頭数はかなりのものだ。:
Very well. I leave the formation to you, Prince.
However, the enemy numbers are quite substantial.
m400573.アリガトウ、王国海軍ヨ！\nアリガトウ、王子ヨ！:
Thank you, Kingdom Navy!
Thank you, Prince!
m400573.ギャギャ！ メカゴブリンクイーンサマ！\nクイーンサマミテル！ ガンバル！！:
Gyagyaa! Mecha Goblin Queen-sama!
Queen-sama, look! We'll do our best!!
m400573.クックック。\nコレだけの財宝がアレバ！\nメカゴブリンクイーン様に最高のプレゼ:
Kukuuku.
With treasure this abundant!
I'll make the perfect gift for the Mecha Goblin Queen...!
m400573.ゴブリンにはそういう文化がない可能性もある。\n正式に抗議して、それで聞いてくれ:
It's possible the goblins simply don't have such customs.
I propose we file a formal protest. If they refuse to listen,
we should perhaps give them a strong warning.
m400573.ゴブリン軍団は物質界連合の一員ではありますが、\n未だ、解散後には敵対すると公言:
While the Goblin Legion is a member of the Material World Alliance,
they have publicly declared their hostility since the dissolution,
making them a potential threat……
m400573.フフッ、フフフッ……。\n夢が無限に広がル……！！:
Heheh, heheheh...
My dreams are expanding infinitely...!!
m400573.メカゴブリンクイーンの配下を騙る、\n別勢力のゴブリンである可能性もあります。:
There is also the possibility that these are goblins from a different faction,
pretending to be under the command of the Mech-Goblin Queen.
m400573.メカゴブリンクイーン様！\nステキな贈り物、待っていてクダサレー！！:
Mech Goblin Queen!
Please wait for a wonderful gift!!
m400573.丸く……収まったということで？\nともあれ、王子、お疲れ様でした！:
So... everything's settled?
In any case, good work, Prince!
m400573.今は物質界連合の仲間だろう？\n今後も、できれば協力関係であり続けたいが。:
You're part of the Material World Alliance now, aren't you?
I'd like us to keep working together, if possible.
m400573.合同調査だって可能だし、\n発見者として取り分の要求だってできただろうに。:
A joint investigation would have been possible,
and we could have claimed a share as the discoverers.
m400573.戦闘になっても、現場は私たちの縄張りだ。\n船団で囲んで、負傷者はしっかり回収す:
Even if it comes to battle, this is our turf.
We'll surround them with our fleet and make sure to recover all the wounded.
m400573.方向舵が壊れたようだったから、\n軍艦で牽引してあげないとかしら？:
Her rudder seemed to be broken,
so wouldn't it be kind to tow her with a warship?
m400573.気にする必要はないわ！\n私には、アナタが造った新型兵器、\nゴブリン武装潜水艦:
Don't worry about it!
I have the new weapon you built for me,
the Goblin Armed Submarine!
m400573.沈没船……？\nここ数年、この海域での沈没報告は受けていないぞ？:
A sunken ship...?
We haven't received any reports of sinkings in these waters in recent years, have we?
m400573.海上演習を王国領内でするつもりなら、\n正式に届け出をしろと伝えてみたが、\nこ:
I told them that if they intended to conduct naval exercises within our borders, they should file a formal notice.
But they insisted they were merely anchoring there.
m400573.王国法にも類似の記述がありますし、\n王子だって駄目とは言わないかと……。:
The Kingdom's laws have similar provisions,
so I don't think the Prince would object...
m400573.王子、ゴブリン軍団が来ます！\n指揮をお願いします！:
Prince, the goblin horde is coming!
Please take command!
m400573.見逃してあげていいんじゃないですか？: Shouldn't we just let him off?
m400573.軍事行動と略奪を一緒にするな、まったく。\n――よし、それじゃあ各員出撃の準備を:
Don't conflate military operations with plundering. Ridiculous.
Now then, everyone, prepare for departure.
The "Grand Subjugation Mission" is a go!
m400573.難しい理屈付けは終わったか？: Is that the end of the legalistic argument?
m400573.黄金の首飾り……イヤ、\n光り輝く全身像……ッ！！\nイヤイヤイヤ、ココはモウ、:
A golden necklace... no,
a shining full-body statue...!!
No, no, no, here it is, a golden ring...!!

m920229.――なんて、鳥人の里の方が\n大慌てで飛び込んできた時は心配しましたが。\nなる:
――Well, when the bird-folk from the village
rushed in in a panic, I was worried, but.
I see, the festival egg decorations really have been stolen.
m920229.――み、皆様！\nすみません、助けてくださいっ！:
―E-Everyone!
I'm so sorry, please help me!
m920229.――わかりました。\nそこまでいうなら、私が相手になります！:
―I understand.
If it comes to that, I will take it on myself!
m920229.――ガッハッハッハッハ！\n参った参ったァ！:
――Gahahaha!
You've got me! You really have me!
m920229.――ホウ、力比べか、\nなかなか面白そうなことをしているな。:
――Hoh, a test of strength, eh?
You're up to something rather interesting.
m920229.――兎が主役の\nぴょんぴょんばにー祭りなるものがあるらしいね。:
――I hear there's a “Bouncy Bunny Festival”
where rabbits are the stars of the show.
m920229.――猫さんを数日前に拾った？: ――You picked up a cat a few days ago?
m920229.……えっぐぱーてぃとかそんな名前じゃなかったか？: ……Wasn't it called something like the “Egg Party”?
m920229.……ここまで褒められると、照れてしまいますね。\nうふふっ、ありがとうございます:
……You're making me blush with all that praise.
Hehe, thank you, Luthier.
m920229.……もふもふもこもこで、ちょっと羨ましいかも。: ……All that fluff and fluffiness… I'm a little jealous, maybe.
m920229.……キャスパリーグ、\n無邪気だしもこもこだし、無理に倒さなくていいかも。: ……Caspar League is so innocent and fluffy… Maybe we don't have to force ourselves to take it down after all.
m920229.……確かに、そうかもしれないな。\nまぁ、倒すべきだと提言した手前、\n意見を変:
……You may be right.
I'm well aware that changing my mind now, after I was the one who recommended we subdue it, isn't ideal, but…
m920229.あ、ありがとうございますっ。\nそう言っていただけると、助かります……！:
Oh, thank you.
It really helps to hear you say that…!
m920229.あ、アナベラさん……！\nありがとうございますっ！:
Oh, Anabella…!
Thank you so much!
m920229.あぁ……猫の魔物さんたちが去っていく……。: Ah… the cat monsters are leaving…
m920229.あぁ、本当ですね……。\nでは落ち着いたら、手入れをお願いしちゃいましょうか。:
Ah, you're right…
Well, once we've settled in, I'll have to ask you to groom me.
m920229.あっ！ あれは盗まれた卵飾りですわ！\nそれに……ね、猫ちゃんが大量にいますわー:
Ah! Those are the stolen egg decorations!
And… oh my, there are so many cats here!
m920229.あと、この場にはいませんがジタリスさんも……。\n――おや？ あそこにあるのは…:
And, though he isn't here right now, Gitalis is…
―Oh my? What is that over there…?
m920229.あの……あなたはどちらかというと、\n奉納される側では……？: Um…… you're more on the side of being the one receiving the tribute, aren't you?
m920229.あのー……。\nジタリスさんが拾ったっていう猫なんですけど……。:
Um…
This is the cat that Gitalis picked up…
m920229.あの感じ、ついて来てって言ってるみたいだった。\n遊び場を変えたいってことかも…:
From the way it did it, it looked like it was telling us to follow.
Maybe it wants to change its play area…
m920229.あの時の勇敢なる人類か、久しいな。\n天の岩戸の外が騒がしくて来てみれば、\n奉:
The brave humans from that day, it's been a while.
I heard it was noisy outside the Heavenly Rock Cave,
and I see you're holding a tribute exhibition match.
m920229.いえ、これはたぶん、\nじゃれつこうとしているだけだと思います。:
No, I think it's just
trying to play with us.
m920229.いきなり玉兎を召喚しやがった！？\nまさか、神獣と俺たちを戦わせるつもりか！:
You just summoned Gyokuto out of nowhere?!
You're not actually planning to pit a Divine Beast against us, are you?
m920229.いずれにしても、ジタリスさんが連れて行かれた以上、\nこのまま放っておくわけには:
Either way, since it took Gitalis with it,
we can't just leave them there.
m920229.いや、でも戦ったおかげなのか、\nなんだか嬉しそうに見えますよ……？:
No, but maybe it's because we fought it…
It actually looks pretty happy, don't you think?
m920229.いやいや、まさかそんなに大きくなっているわけ……。: No, no, surely it can't have gotten that big…
m920229.うふふっ、この子ったら王子様が大好きみたいですね。\nはやく遊んで欲しいって言っ:
Hehe, this little one seems to adore the Prince.
It looks like it's begging to play right away.
m920229.うん、さすが王子！\nキャスパリーグが来ても問題ないってさ！:
Yes, just like the Prince!
It's no problem even if Caspar League shows up!
m920229.うん、そうだね。\n悪さをしたご先祖さまとは別の子だもん。\n同じようになるとは:
Yeah, I think so too.
It's a different child from its mischievous ancestors.
It doesn't have to turn out the same way.
m920229.えぇ、とってももふもふですよ。\nリュティエさんがすっぽり埋まるくらいには。:
Yes, it's incredibly fluffy.
Fluffy enough for you to sink right into it, Luthier.
m920229.えぇ、分かりましたっ。\nうふふっ、リュティエさんとエクスさんと、\n一緒に戦え:
Yes, of course.
Hehe, I'm so happy to be fighting alongside you, Luthier, and Aix!
m920229.えぇ、絶対に。\n私が主治医として、そして親代わりとして、\n怪物にならないよう:
Yes, absolutely.
As its doctor and as a sort of parent,
I'll make sure it never becomes a monster.
m920229.えぇっ！？ もうそんな時間！？\n大変だ、早く会場に向かわないと！:
Ehh!? It's already that time!?
Oh no, I have to get to the venue quickly!
m920229.えっ、ボクが触っちゃっていいの！？: Huh? You want me to do it!?
m920229.おっと、そろそろ出番だ！\nみんな、かっこいいところみせるよ！:
Oh, my turn is coming up!
Everyone, I'm going to show you all how cool I am!
m920229.かの神々を、見事に討ち取ってみせたか。: You have managed to defeat those gods.
m920229.こうして王子様と仲良くしている姿を見ると、\nきっとこの子は大丈夫だって、そう思:
Seeing it get along so well with the Prince,
I truly believe this one will be all right.
m920229.これからは、人の時代、か――。: From now on, it shall be the age of humans――.
m920229.これだけ人に懐ているなら、\n無理に討伐する必要もないのかもしれないな。\nもち:
If it's grown this attached to people,
perhaps there really is no need to hunt it down.
Of course, we'll still need to keep a close eye on it.
m920229.これは……まさか妖猫キャスパリーグか？: Could this be… the demon cat, Caspar League?
m920229.これより、エッグパーティのメインイベント、\n王国軍を交えての模擬戦をとりおこな:
And now, for the main event of the Egg Party,
we shall hold a mock battle involving the Royal Army!
m920229.こんな巨体でじゃれつかれたら\n襲われてるのと同じですよ……！？:
Being pounced on by something that size
is the same as being attacked…!
m920229.しかもあの子は猫の魔物たちとも仲が良かったみたいで、\n影響された猫たちが真似を:
On top of that, it seems it got along well with the cat monsters,
and the ones who were influenced by it started copying it…
m920229.すごい！ もふもふだよ！\n猫の魔物さんたちで一面もふもふの楽園じゃん！:
Amazing! They're so fluffy!
It's like a fluffy paradise made of cat monsters!
m920229.すごくもふもふでとっても可愛いけど、\nただの猫さんではないことは確かだと思うよ:
It's incredibly fluffy and adorable, but
I think it's safe to say it's not just a regular cat!
m920229.せ、成長している……？\nそれっていいことなんじゃないの？:
G-Growing fast…?
Isn't that a good thing?
m920229.せっかくだ、オレも混ぜてもらおう！\nフン！ フン！ ドスコーイ！:
Since I'm here, count me in!
Hmph! Hmph! Doskoi!
m920229.そういえばそうだっけ。\nなら、ボクもジタリスと一緒に戦えて嬉しいよ！:
Now that you mention it, that's true.
In that case, I'm happy to fight on your side, Gitalis!
m920229.そうだね、キャスパリーグを追いかけよう！: Right, let's go after Caspar League!
m920229.そうですね……あっ！駄目ですよっ。\nまた卵飾りを持っていったら！:
I suppose so…… Ah! No, that won't do.
It's gone off with the egg decorations again!
m920229.そうなんですけど、普通じゃないといいますか……。\nいえ、たぶん直接見てもらった:
It is, but it's not quite normal, if you know what I mean…
No, I think it's best if you just see for yourself.
m920229.その上でも神殺しとして驕ることなく、\n古き神々相手に、\nこうして奉納相撲まで:
And yet, despite your reputation as a god-slayer,
you have not grown arrogant.
You even go so far as to perform a tribute sumo match
against the ancient gods.
m920229.その子は日に日に回復していったのですが、\n元気になるにつれて活発になって……。:
It's been getting better day by day, but
as it regained its strength, it's become quite lively…
m920229.その怪物の名が、キャスパリーグ。\nおそらく目の前にいるのは、\n大昔に退治され:
That monster is known as Caspar League.
The one before us is likely a descendant of the individual that was slain long ago.
m920229.それじゃあ、卵飾り持って会場に戻ろうか！\nエッグパーティの準備をしなきゃだもん:
Well then, let's head back to the venue with the egg decorations!
We still have to prepare for the Egg Party!
m920229.それで久しぶりに外に出たところ、\n丸い物……卵飾りを気に入ったらしく、\n住処:
So, when I let it outside for the first time in a while,
it seemed to take a liking to round objects… the egg decorations,
and it carried them off to its new home.
m920229.それで結局、キャスパリーグはどうなったの？: So, what happened with Caspar League in the end?
m920229.それと、お手入れ道具を貸すよ。\nほら、キャスパリーグにじゃれつかれて、\nつや:
Also, I'll lend you some grooming tools.
Look, Caspar League has been playing with you,
and your sleek feathers are all ruffled.
m920229.それに、キャスパリーグも\nジタリスと一緒に遊べて嬉しそうだったよ！\nだから良:
And besides, Caspar League seemed so happy
to play with Gitalis!
So I think it all turned out well!
m920229.それはそうだが、\nこの子がずっとアスガルドにとどまってくれるとも限らない。\n:
That may be true, but
there's no guarantee this one will stay in Asgard forever.
It could pose a danger to the Avian Village as well…
m920229.それもあるのですが……。\n拾ったあの子はなんというか、すごく成長しているんです:
That's part of it, but…
the one I picked up is, well, growing really fast.
m920229.そんなことないって！\nつやつやでぴかぴかだし、とっても綺麗だし！\nなんていう:
They're not!
They're so sleek and shiny, and really beautiful!
It's just… they're incredibly majestic!
m920229.そんなのダメだよ！\nせっかく兎さんの可愛い格好してるんだから、\n卵を取り戻し:
No way!
Since I'm dressed up so cutely as a bunny,
we have to get the eggs back and make it a fun Egg Party!
m920229.たいへんです！\nエッグパーティの卵飾りが盗まれてしまいました！:
This is bad!
The Egg Party decorations have been stolen!
m920229.ただあの子は、\n模擬戦が大好きになっちゃったみたいで――: It's just that the little one has become absolutely obsessed with mock battles――
m920229.だけどこんなに可愛い子が\n将来都市を滅ぼすような魔物になるなんて、\nそんなの:
But the thought of such a cute little one
growing up to be a monster that could destroy a city…
That would be a shame for Caspar League too!
m920229.だとしても駄目です！\n悪さをしたのはご先祖さまで、この子には罪はありません！:
I can't allow that!
It was its ancestors who caused the trouble, not this one!
m920229.ていうかこっちに襲いかかろうとしていない！？: And isn't it trying to attack us right now?!
m920229.で、でしたら後で撫でてみてはいかがでしょう……？\nこの子も、皆様のことを気に入:
W-Why don't you try petting it later…?
It seems to have taken a liking to all of you…
It should let you pet it easily!
m920229.でしたら近寄ってそっと起こして追い払いましょう\nとにかく平和的に、卵飾りを回収:
In that case, let's approach them gently, wake them up, and shoo them away.
We'll retrieve the decorations peacefully, no matter what.
m920229.ですが、どのみち落ち着かせる必要はありますわ！\n遊びたがりなキャスパリーグが来:
But we still need to calm it down!
Caspar League is a playful sort!
m920229.ですが、満足してもらえたようで良かったです！\n皆さんのおかげで、上手く奉納でき:
But I'm glad you seem satisfied!
Thanks to everyone, the tribute went off without a hitch!
m920229.でも、そろそろエッグパーティがはじまるわ。\nイヨは行かなくていいの？\n卵をた:
But the Egg Party is about to start.
Aren't you going?
You were so excited about finding lots of eggs, weren't you?
m920229.でもあんなに可愛い猫さん、\n遠距離攻撃で無理やり起こすなんて絶対にできないよ！:
But those cats are so adorable,
there's no way I could force them awake with a ranged attack!
m920229.でもエクス、とっても似合ってるって！\nどこからどう見ても可愛い兎さんだよ！:
But, Aix, it really suits you!
No matter how you look at it, you're an adorable bunny!
m920229.というか、自然にこの子と一緒に戦ってしまいました……！\nみ、皆様っ、大丈夫でし:
Besides, we ended up fighting alongside it naturally…!
E-Everyone… are you all alright…!?
m920229.というわけで、我が前にいでよ、\n大いなる鏡像――神獣「玉兎」っ！！:
So come before me,
great mirror image――Divine Beast, “Gyokuto”!!
m920229.というわけで、王国らしく奉納模擬戦をみんなでやろうよ！: So let's all put on a proper royal tribute exhibition match!
m920229.とっても喜んでるみたいだし、\nそれにこんな無邪気な姿を見せられたら、\n倒そう:
It really does seem to be enjoying itself.
And seeing such an innocent side of it…
It makes it hard to bring yourself to defeat it…
m920229.とっても嬉しそうだね。\nそれにジタリスの言うこともちゃんと聞いてるし、\nこの:
It looks so happy.
And it's listening to what Gitalis says, too,
so I don't think it's likely to cause any trouble.
m920229.とはいえ今は模擬戦の最中ですし、\nこの子の相手をしてあげられるかは……。:
That said, we are in the middle of a mock battle,
so I'm not sure if I can spare the time to look after it…
m920229.とんでもないものを拾ってきましたねー！？: You really picked up quite the trouble, didn't you…?
m920229.どうやら、また遊んでもらいたくて\nここまで来たみたいですね。: It looks like it came all this way because it wants to play again.
m920229.どんどん上機嫌になっていますね……。\nもしかするとキャスパリーグは、\n私たち:
It's getting more and more cheerful…
Perhaps Caspar League thinks we're playing with it.
m920229.なるほど、それで猫の群れが\n卵飾りで遊んだりしていたのですね。:
I see. So that's why the swarm of cats
was playing with the egg decorations.
m920229.は、はい……じゃれつかれて、\nちょっとふらふらしますけど……。:
Y-Yes… It's been playing rough with me,
so I'm a little dizzy…
m920229.はぁ、はぁっ……。\n相変わらずの力自慢でしたわね……！:
Haa, haa…….
As always, you're just showing off your strength……!
m920229.はい、怪我をした子猫を見つけたので\n手当をして保護したんです。:
Yes, I found a kitten that was injured,
so I treated it and took it in.
m920229.ふっふっふ、祝祭に際して、\nうさぴょん……玉兎に奉納しよう思ってね。:
Fu fu fu, in honor of the festival,
I thought we'd offer a tribute to the bunny…… I mean, Gyokuto.
m920229.ふふ、大丈夫ですよ。\n誰も怪我なんてしていませんし。:
Hehe, we're fine.
No one got hurt, after all.
m920229.ふーん、それで猫さんが大変だー、\nって助けを求めにきたってことかな。: Hm, so you came asking for help because things got out of hand with the cats.
m920229.ほ、本当に触っちゃっていいの？\n鳥人さんの羽に触るなんて恐れ多すぎるんだけど！:
R-Really? I can touch them?
It's a bit terrifying to touch a bird-person's feathers!
m920229.ほ、褒めていただけるのは嬉しいのですが……！\nそれを言うならリュティエさんこそ:
W-Well, I appreciate the compliment, but…!
If anything, Luthier, you're the one who really knows how to pull off an outfit. It looks wonderful on you.
m920229.ほら、今回の騒動では、\nおふたりと戦ってばかりでしたから……。: Well, considering all the trouble recently, I've been fighting against you two the whole time…
m920229.まぁ、うさぴょんも楽しそうだったし奉納は大成功だね！: Well, Bunny Hop seemed to have a great time, so the tribute was a huge success!
m920229.まだ興奮していますけど、\nこのまま遊んであげたら落ち着きそう――きゃっ！？:
It's still quite worked up, but
if we keep playing with it, it should calm down—Kyaa!?
m920229.み、皆様……。\nどうやら、この子は成体になったみたいです……。\nその、ちょう:
E-Everyone…
It looks like this one has reached its adult form…
It was right in the middle of its growth spurt, I suppose…
m920229.も、もう、そんなに身を寄せなくても、\nどこかに行ったりしませんから……！:
N-Now, you don't have to cling to me that much,
I'm not going anywhere…!
m920229.もちろんですっ。\nお手数をおかけしますが、皆様よろしくお願いします！:
Of course!
I'm sorry for the trouble, but please take care of this for us!
m920229.もちろん私たちが、\n都市を滅ぼすような怪物にならないよう、\nしっかり面倒を見:
Of course, we still need to keep a close eye on it
to make sure it doesn't become a monster that could destroy the city……
m920229.よく分かりませんが、\nどのみち卵飾りは取り戻さなければいけませんし、\n案内を:
I don't quite follow, but
either way, we need to retrieve the egg decorations.
Could you show us the way?
m920229.ら、来年の奉納は、祭りのイベントに組み込んでもらおう！\nみんなー！ 会場に急げ:
L-let's include next year's tribute in the festival events!
Everyone! Hurry to the venue!!
m920229.アナベラさん！\nもしかして何かご存じなんですか？:
Anabella!

Caspar League…!?

Caspar League has
bit Gitalis and carried them off somewhere…!

It seems Caspar League and the others are satisfied,
so let's call it a day.

Caspar League is having a blast.

but how about we share a few eggs with it once it's over?

Gitalis? Why are you here…?

Luthier is getting quite excited, but…
The egg decorations were made by the village children, with love put into every single one.
m920229.リュティエさんほど素敵な人なら、\nあの子のブラッシングもお願いしちゃいましょう:
With someone as wonderful as you, Luthier, I suppose I can entrust you with brushing that little one too.
I did recommend you give it a stroke, after all♪

That is why the Heavens have decided to host
an Egg Party this year, but…

but as a neighbor, I will lend you a hand.

It was a monstrous feline that the Hero King once fought and defeated.

I don't think the bunny outfit has anything to do with it, though…

With the egg decorations missing,
the festival is going to feel a bit bland, I'm afraid.

We won't be able to contain it until it calms down.

It's a pity, but…
we should probably defeat it while it's still young.

We got to see those cute cat monsters up close, too.

You look like a dad who wants to play with his kids.

It's attached to you in an unusual way.
At this rate, it'll be impossible to separate it from Caspar League.
m920229.怪我が治るまで安静にさせていましたから。\n完治したとはいえ、体力がついてこなか:
Oh, yes.
You seem to be good at it, Luthier,
and I actually prefer having someone else groom me.
m920229.成長した猫さんかぁ……。\nきっとすごくもふもふなんだろうなぁ。:
A grown-up cat, huh…
It's probably really fluffy, I bet.

Cats… or perhaps, monsters?

m920229.猫が、大変なことになっているんですっ！: The cats are in terrible trouble!

It's a shame for the cats, but after we retrieve the decorations,
let's promise to give them some other eggs as a gift.
m920229.猫の魔物たちを追えば、きっと残りも回収できるはずです。\nですからこのまま群れを:
If we track the cat monsters, we should be able to retrieve the rest.
So, let's keep following the swarm and―

Even the veterinarian was baffled by it.
So this one really isn't just an ordinary cat, is it…?

I'm sorry, everyone.

I don't care about the details!
What matters is that rabbits are the main attraction!

I've heard that the Caspar League the Hero King defeated
grew into a monster capable of destroying an entire city.

To calm it down, it looks like we'll have to play with it
until it's tired…!

What brings you out at this hour?

That way, he won't have to rely on the warrior class for military power.

I have a favor to ask of you warriors.

At least you're fast on your feet, huh!
Come on, wild child!

but Douman possesses the power to force yokai into submission.

This nation and the yokai are inseparable.

My father and I were always the ones stepping in to mediate, and yet—

This is what's known as a "treacherous minister."
He's deceiving the young Emperor and doing whatever he pleases.
m930023.これは単純な比較の問題よ。\nどちらを生かした方が得なのか、\n自分の器の程度は:
It's a simple matter of comparison.
Which of us is more valuable to keep alive?
I know my own limitations.
m930023.これも世の常よな、殺せ。: Such is the way of the world. Kill her.

From this point on, I enter the path of the Asura!
If you lack the resolve to slay demons, get out of here!
m930023.これより拙者、シズカ殿にお味方申す。: From this moment, I pledge my blade to you, Lady Shizuka.

I suppose I have no choice but to set an example for everyone else.

Well then, let's start by looking back at the Imperial Court's policy.
Their stated goal of exterminating the yokai is, as you all know, practically impossible.
m930023.さてもさてもそこもとら、\nまさか今さら死にたくないなど、\nどうか言ってくださ:
Come now, come now, you there.
Please don't say something so foolish as "I don't want to die yet."
m930023.しょうがねぇよ、馬鹿でビビりだもん。: Let's take them all down in one go!

m930023.そういうのが嫌だって話をしたかったんだけどなぁ。: I was hoping we could avoid that kind of talk.

That name, and that title……
Could it be…… the cursed blade Murasame?

m930023.そもそもうちの子じゃないわよ。: She's not even one of our people.
m930023.それが必要なのは貴様の方だ。: That's what you need to do.

If we map their roles onto our Kingdom,
the Emperor would be like the Prince, the aristocracy like Lady Anna, and the warrior class like Lady Meireu?
m930023.それだけ期待されてるってことだと思うようにするよ。: I guess I'll just think of it as a sign that he has high expectations for me.

m930023.それで、早速ノリモチくんに頼みたいことがあって──: So, I have something I'd like to ask you to do right away, Norimochi──
m930023.それは拙者も探しておる最中なのですが……結構！: I am still searching for that answer myself…… But never mind!
m930023.それを決めるのは貴様ではなく帝よ。\n疑いが晴れるまで東に帰れると思うな。:
It is not for you to decide, but for the Emperor.
Do not think you can return to the East until the suspicion is cleared.
m930023.ちょ、やめなさい！ いたっ、痛いから！\n生きてる！ ちゃんとまだ生きてるってば: Hey, stop it! Ow, that hurts! I'm alive! I'm still very much alive!
m930023.ちょっと、この時間にどこに行く気よ？: Hey, where do you think you're going at this hour?
m930023.てんで駄目ね、公家の人材不足は深刻かしら。: You're hopeless. The court's talent shortage is serious, isn't it?

So, what is Douman thinking?
He doesn't want to destroy the yokai.
He wants to remake them into his shikigami.
m930023.ではでは、まず倒れている方々にこの針を打ちます。: Then, first, I'll give the unconscious ones this needle.

Oh, I'm just a wandering ronin passing by.
Allow me to take the lead for a moment.
Use the time to catch your breath.

Then select those benevolent yokai of yours
and take them back to your country.
We have no intention of pursuing them beyond our borders.

m930023.はっはっは、敵が一人増えた程度で及び腰ですなぁ。: Hahaha, you're getting nervous over just one more enemy?

m930023.ぼくがちゃんとドウマン様に執り成してやるからさー！: I'm going to properly mediate with Lord Douman, so…!
m930023.ぼくだって兵部卿になったんだからな！？\nいつまでも昔のぼくと同じだと思うなよ！:
Oh, is that so? I do remember you mentioning that.
Congratulations on becoming the Minister of War!
m930023.まあ、これまでにもう六回ぐらい\n暗殺者を送られてるんですけどねー。: Well, they've sent assassins after us about six times already, though.
m930023.まあまあ、どうせ御上に使い潰されるのがオチでしたよ。: Now, now. You were going to be used up and discarded by the lord anyway.
m930023.もうよい、言い訳の前に足を使え。\n貴様の代わりはいくらでもいることを忘れるな。:
Enough. Use your legs before you start making excuses.
Don't forget that I can replace you with anyone.
m930023.もしかしたら和解の道も見つかるかもしれない。: Maybe we can find a path to reconciliation.
m930023.もしもドウマンを倒せなければ、\nこの国が再び群雄割拠の時代に戻り、\nまた戦で:
If we fail to defeat Douman,
this country will fall back into an age of warring states,
and thousands more will lose their lives in war.
m930023.や、その、なんか、普通に帰れちゃったっていうか──: U-um, well, I guess I just came home like it was nothing……
m930023.やば、今回の元凶じゃん。\n検非違使ー！ 検非違使ー！\nここに事件の犯人がいま:
Yikes, she's the ringleader this time.
Kembitui! Kembitui!
The culprit of the incident is right here!
m930023.よく来てくれたな、ヨシノ。\n急な呼び出し、訝しく思うたことだろう。:
You've come, Yoshino.
I imagine this sudden summons raised some eyebrows.
m930023.よし、これで全員無事に帰還できたね。\nみんな朝廷がどんな状況か把握できたろう。:
Good, everyone is back safely.
I assume you all have a grasp of the court's current situation.
We need to discuss our strategy against Douman.
m930023.よしよし、それじゃあ帰んべ帰んべ。: Alright, alright. Let's head home, shall we?
m930023.よーし、全員武器下ろして―。: Lady Yoshino, I take full responsibility for this as your steward—
m930023.キシシ、見事なものよなぁ。: Kishiishi, that was quite the spectacle.
m930023.シズカ、見事だった。お前の勝ちだよ、武器を捨てろ。: Shizuka, well done. You've won. Put down your weapon.
m930023.セイメイさんが表に出てくれたら良いのでは？: Wouldn't it be better if you went out in public, Seimei?
m930023.セイメイよ、地獄で見ているか？\n貴様が育てたこの国、儂が壊してくれようぞ。:
Seimei, are you watching from hell?
Let me shatter this nation you nurtured.
m930023.チェルシーちゃん偉い！ 百年無税！: Good job, Chelsea! You're exempt from taxes for a hundred years!
m930023.ドウマン様！？ どうしてこちらに！: Lord Douman!? Why are you here!
m930023.ヨシノ、汝には知る限りの情報を吐いてもらおう。: Yoshino, you will surrender all the information you possess.
m930023.ヨシノ殿よ、ここは逆に考えられてはどうだ？\n風神雷神、ぬらりひょん、酒呑童子、:
Lady Yoshino, perhaps you should look at it from the other side?
Fujin, Raijin, Nurarihyon, Shuten-doji, Ootakemaru…
m930023.一気に捕まえるわよ！: Master! We're running out of time!
m930023.三人で遊んだのが懐かしいわね！: I miss the days when we three played together!
m930023.事前に結界を張っておいたので、\n音は外部に漏れていないはずです。\n師匠の術に:
I set up a barrier beforehand, so
the sound shouldn't have leaked outside.
It's not as good as Master's techniques, though──
m930023.人質になってあの子の足を引っ張るぐらいなら、\n此処で一人でも多く道連れにして死:
Rather than becoming a hostage and holding that girl back,
I'll take as many of you down with me as I can and die here.
m930023.今から対式神の陣法を授ける、一晩で覚えなさい。: I will now teach you the formation for countering shikigami. Memorize it by tonight.
m930023.今から徹夜で準備だよ、トホホ……。: So I'm going to be working all night to get ready. Ugh……
m930023.今まで武家の盾に隠れていたうらなり風情が、\n帝の権勢を笠に着た途端に強者面とは:
You who hid behind the warrior class's shield,
the moment you wield the Emperor's authority, you act like the strong? How laughable!
m930023.今回は初心者さんたちもいるからねー、\n前提の共有はこまめにやっとかないと。: We've got some newbies with us, so I need to make sure everyone's on the same page.
m930023.今後一週間の帝やドウマンの予定に関連するもの。\nとりあえず手当たり次第にね、内:
Anything related to the Emperor's or Douman's schedule for the next week.
We'll grab everything we can find. I'll sort through the contents myself.
m930023.似たような存在にいくつか心当たりがあるのよ。: I know a few beings of a similar nature.
m930023.何の権利があって帝の決定に異を唱えるのか。\nいかに物質界の盟主とて道理というも:
On what grounds do you dare challenge the Emperor's decision?
Even if you are the leader of the Material World, there is a limit to reason.
I will not bow to the threats of the Kingdom's military might and prestige.
m930023.何をしたらそんなに恨まれるんですか……？: What did you do to make him hate you that much……?
m930023.何をしておるノリモチ、早う行かぬか。: What are you doing, Norimochi? Hurry up!
m930023.何を驚く、先の芸神例祭を忘れたわけではなかろう。\nそなたらの挺身なくては朕の命:
Why the shock? You haven't forgotten the recent Geishin Festival, I hope.
Without your efforts, my life would have been in grave danger.
I can no longer stand by while they pose such a threat.
m930023.儂は譲歩した、それ以上は内政干渉と見做す。: I have made a concession. Anything more I will view as interference in our internal affairs.
m930023.先代国主の娘って……。: The daughter of the former Lord…
m930023.公家文化に憧れるのは結構ですけどね、\n腹芸のできない殿には朝廷は無理です。:
It's all well and good to admire courtly culture, but
the imperial court is no place for a lord who can't read the room.
m930023.共存、なるほど確かに理想的な未来ではある。\nしかし、その過程で犠牲になる民草は:
Coexistence. I suppose it is an idealistic future.
But how many commoners will be sacrificed in the process?
The capital was attacked, and the Emperor's safety was threatened. That is a fact.
m930023.兵部卿、儂はヨシノを殺せと言うたはずよのぅ？\nそれがなにを、侍一匹にここまで手:
Minister of War, I told you to kill Yoshino.
And what have you done? Struggling against a single samurai.
m930023.出たよ、武家の裏切り者が。\n美味しそうな名前しやがって、\n焼いて醤油に浸して:
So the traitor of the warrior class has shown his face.
What a delicious-sounding name.
I wonder if I should roast you up and dip you in soy sauce.
m930023.別に、私はノリモチのこと結構好きだもん。\n今時珍しいよ、あれだけ裏表がない大名:
Wanting to rise in rank for the sake of his beloved subordinates and people...
It's impressive that he can say that while sober.
m930023.勅命とあらば、参上するまでにございます。: If it is an imperial command, then I am duty-bound to appear.
m930023.君は先代の娘だぞ。: You are the former Lord's daughter.
m930023.問われて名乗るもおこがましいが！: It would be presumptuous to state my name when asked!
m930023.国主を狙え！ 武家の棟梁を殺せ！: Aim for the ruler! Kill the head of the warrior class!
m930023.夜中に大内裏へ忍び込むなんて、バレたら打ち首ね。: Sneaking into the Imperial Palace in the middle of the night…… if we get caught, we'll be beheaded.
m930023.大丈夫大丈夫、武家で面倒見てあげるからねー。: It's fine, it's fine. We'll take care of them as warriors should.
m930023.大好きな部下や領民のために出世したいとか、\nあれを素面で言えるんだから大したも:
Becoming Douman's lapdog is infuriating, though.
I'm reflecting on the fact that I failed to discipline him properly.
m930023.大妖と呼ばれる存在でもなければ抵抗は難しいだろう。\nつまり、あいつは式神だけの:
Unless they are great yokai, resistance would be nearly impossible.
In other words, he intends to build an army composed entirely of shikigami.
m930023.大師匠ぅ、私も行けますよぉ？: Grand Master, I can keep going too?
m930023.大罪だ、逆賊だ、ぼくはもう終わりなんだぁ……。: High treason, sedition…… I'm done for……
m930023.大義の御旗がドウマン側にある以上、\n国を守り続けたきみたち武家であっても、\n:
As long as the banner of righteousness is on Douman's side,
even you warriors, who have defended the nation,
will find it difficult to win the people's support.
m930023.大義を圧倒的武力で踏み潰すか、\n帝の側に控えるドウマンを除くか。:
We either crush the opposing "righteous" force with overwhelming military power,
or we eliminate Douman, who stands at the Emperor's side.
m930023.妖怪の中には我ら王国の友人も多くいます。\n彼らは世界を救うために共に戦った同胞:
Many of the yokai are friends of our Kingdom.
They are comrades who fought alongside us to save the world.
They should not be subjected to baseless persecution.
m930023.妖怪総大将か……儂も話には聞いておる。\nだが、その名にどれほどの意味があると言:
The General of the Yokai, is it… I've heard the rumors.
But what weight does that name actually carry?
m930023.存外、虎の器であったか。見くびっておったわ。\n気骨のある武士を手にかけるのは忍:
She has more spirit than I expected. I underestimated her.
It pains me to strike down a warrior of such backbone, but──
m930023.実はな、朕は近日中に諸国へと宣旨を下すつもりだ。\nこの国に蔓延る妖怪ども、その:
In fact, I intend to issue an imperial decree to all the provinces soon.
I will order the total annihilation of the yokai that have overrun this land.
m930023.実は今朝方に朝廷から呼び出しを受けてね。\n罠だとは思うけど、一応は話してみるつ:
Actually, we received a summons from the court this morning.
I suspect it's a trap, but I intend to go and talk to them just in case.
m930023.将を射んとする者はまず馬を射よってね。\n東の国を式神が支配する国にしようだって:
To shoot the general, first shoot the horse.
They want to turn the Eastern Kingdom into a nation ruled by shikigami?
m930023.少しの間だけでも情報を撹乱できるだけで上々だよ。: Even if it only throws off their information gathering for a little while, that's a win in my book.
m930023.帝に逆らう逆賊を捕らえよ！: Seize the rebels who defy the Emperor!
m930023.式神って、ミコトさんたちが使役している……。: Shikigami, like the ones Mikoto and the others command…
m930023.強引に連れ出しておいてなんだけど、\nそういうわけで王子たちは宿で留守番を──:
I know I'm dragging you along against your will,
but that's why the Princes will stay behind at the inn──
m930023.当然ながらそんなことになれば、\n陰陽師による恐怖政治の始まりだ。:
Naturally, if that comes to pass,
it will mark the beginning of a reign of terror by the onmyoji.
m930023.彼奴らが揃って死に絶えた今この時代こそが、\n我が国から妖怪を掃討するまたとない:
Now that they are all dead, this is the perfect opportunity
to purge yokai from our land.
m930023.恐れながら帝、確かに妖怪は危険な存在です。\nですが、我らの仇敵である大妖はすで:
With all due respect, Your Majesty, yokai are indeed a dangerous presence.
However, the Great Yokai who were our enemies have already passed on,
and the General of the Yokai desires coexistence with humans.
m930023.悪いけど、まだドウマンに生存を知られたくないんだよ。\nあいつ、私が生きてると知:
I'm sorry, but I still don't want Douman to know I'm alive.
If he finds out, he might just blow up the capital along with himself.
m930023.悪かったわよ、ほんと……ただいま。: You're a jerk, you know that…… I'm home.
m930023.我こそは先代国主が一人娘、シズカなり！\n武名惜しまぬ者、功を望む者はかかって参:
I am Shizuka, the only daughter of the former Lord of the Nation!
Those who regret their martial prowess, or those who seek glory, come at me!
Take my head and make it the deed of your lifetime!
m930023.我らに帝に背く意思などあろうはずもありません。: We have no intention of defying the Emperor.
m930023.手の空いた者も参加しなさい。\n式神相手の訓練にはなるだろう。:
Those who are free should join in.
It will serve as training against shikigami.
m930023.抜けば玉散る氷の刃、名をムラサメ──: When drawn, my ice blade scatters like jewels. My name is Murasame──
m930023.故郷に対する気持ちは妖怪とて同じです。\nシノさんに、ヨユキさん、鬼刃姫さんたち:
A youkai's feelings for their homeland are the same.
Shino, Yuyuki, and the Oni Blade Princess…
I'm sure none of them would run away either.
m930023.旧友に情でも湧いたか、くだらん真似を。: Did you feel some old friendship stirring? What a pointless act.
m930023.木っ端大名だった貴様を拾い上げてやったのは誰だ？\nよくも儂の期待を裏切り、斯様:
Who was it who picked you up when you were nothing but a minor lord?
And yet you betray my trust and put on such a wretched display.
m930023.正直なところ私としては大賛成なのですが～、\n現実問題ドウマンをどうやって暗殺す:
Honestly, I'm all for it, but~
how exactly do we assassinate Douman?
m930023.死にかけの公家と朝廷風情が調子に乗りやがってそんなに戦争\nがしたいならやってや: A half-dead courtier and the rest of the imperial court getting all cocky. If you want a war so badly, then have it! You spineless cowards who always hide behind the samurai, and the moment the Emperor returns, you pull this crap?
m930023.死屍累々ですね……。: The bodies are piled up everywhere……
m930023.殺さない程度に眠らせて、処理はチヨメがする。: We'll put them to sleep without killing them. Chiyome will handle the rest.
m930023.殿、落ち着いて。: My lord, please keep your composure.
m930023.殿ぉー、そろそろ限界でーす！:
Hold on! I'll break through this!
Take this, my ultimate Kickball Shot!
m930023.殿が口で負けた！: What can you do? He's a cowardly fool.
m930023.汝が妖怪総大将とやらと通じている以上は、\n先日の一件も偶然では片付けられぬから:
Since you are in contact with this so-called General of the Yokai,
the recent incident cannot be dismissed as a mere coincidence, can it?
m930023.治能力もないくせに喧嘩売ってそれで云十年前に島流しになっ\nたの覚えてないのかよ: You don't have the strength or the leadership to back it up, yet you're picking a fight. Do you not remember being exiled to an island ten years ago? What do you think you're doing, ruining the peace I worked so hard to build? I don't care anymore. Go ahead and kill each other──
m930023.無論、これは貴殿ら武家の功績に他ならぬ。: Of course, this is a testament to the achievements of your warrior class.
m930023.王国で仕入れた直近三刻の記憶が飛ぶ魔法の針です。\nそして現場にお酒の徳利やおつ:
It's a memory-erasing needle I sourced from the Kingdom. It wipes out the last three hours of memory.
After that, I scatter a sake flask and some snacks around the scene, and then just do a little this, that, and the other to make it look natural, and──
m930023.王国を裏から支配したいアンナさんは王子を洗脳し、\nアンジェラさんやアリシアさん:
Lady Anna, who wants to control the Kingdom from the shadows, is brainwashing the Prince.
She's trying to poach Lady Angela and Lady Alicia to her side while eliminating Lady Meireu, who stands in her way!
m930023.理想は大事だが、現実は待ってくれない。\nなに、いざとなれば汚名は全て私が被ると:
Ideals are important, but reality doesn't wait.
Don't worry. If it comes to that, I'll take all the blame myself.
m930023.生き方を教わる前に死んじゃったのよ、あの人。: She died before she could teach me how to live.
m930023.生まれはたたら場、火床の上がり！\n腰に佩かれて諸国を巡り、浮世を歩みし幾歳月。:
Born in a foundry, raised by the forge's heat!
Belted at my waist, I have wandered the provinces for countless years.
I cut down evil in the East and sever demons in the West.
m930023.百の節目を越えてより、年も数えぬ浪人暮らし。\n銭はなけれど心は錆びず、毀れぬ仁:
I've been a wandering samurai for over a hundred years, long since I stopped counting.
I may have no coin in my pocket, but my heart is free of rust,
and I carry an unbroken code of honor.
m930023.知ってるぞ、姫侍だ！: I know her! She's the Princess Warrior!
m930023.私が殿を務める。その隙に離脱しなさい。: I will hold the line. Use the opening to break away.
m930023.私としては適当に理由を付けて断るべきだと思うがね。\nこれは虎穴に入らずんば虎子:
Personally, I think we should find a plausible excuse and refuse.
This isn't a case of "you don't get the tiger's cub without entering the tiger's lair."
m930023.私は、この国に暮らす人々の営みを守りたい。: I want to protect the lives of the people living in this country.
m930023.私はそんなことしません！: I would never do such a thing!
m930023.立っているのもやっとのようだけど。: You barely seem able to stand.
m930023.端的に言うと東の国は現在内戦まで秒読みの状況でね。\n魔物の復活によって棚上げさ:
To put it simply, the Eastern Kingdom is on the brink of civil war.
The conflict between the warrior class and the aristocracy, which had been shelved due to the resurgence of monsters, is flaring up again now that the Western Capital is being rebuilt and the Emperor is returning.
m930023.結局ね、私の器は侍大将止まり。\n前線に立つ以外に能のない武骨者よ。\nそれに比:
In the end, my limit is Grand General of the Samurai.
I'm a roughneck who can do nothing but stand on the front lines.
Compared to you, who has studied governance well.
m930023.行くよシズカ！ コマちゃんは私が守る！: Let's go, Shizuka! I'll protect Komachan!
m930023.見事な啖呵にござった、シズカ殿。\nやはりもののふとはそうでなくては。:
A splendid declaration, Lady Shizuka.
A true warrior must be just like that.
m930023.言い訳は後で聞く、さっさと終わらせよ。: Save your excuses for later. Let's end this quickly.
m930023.話し合いで解決とかは……？: What about trying to resolve this through negotiation...?
m930023.誰のために学んだと思ってる！！: Who do you think I studied for!!
m930023.貴様ら、何をして──: You there, what do you think you're doing──
m930023.逃げられた、か。この雨では足跡も追えぬ。: So we've lost them. In this rain, there are no tracks to follow.
m930023.逃げ足だけは速いもんなァ！？ よっ、野生児！: Do you hate me!? Or are you loyal!?
m930023.遠からん者は音にも聞け！ 近くば寄って目にも見よ！: If you are near, hear my voice! Come close and see me with your own eyes!
m930023.酔って大喧嘩になり全員気絶した宴会場の完成です。: And just like that, we've got a banquet hall where everyone got drunk and started a huge brawl and passed out.
m930023.非礼はお詫びします。しかし、どうかご再考を。: I apologize for the impertinence. But please, reconsider.
m930023.馬鹿殿ォ！ 公家にかぶれてっからそうなんだ！: You're a nobody! You can't kill enemies with Kickball!
m930023.（あれが帝……なんだか、随分と幼いような……）: (That's the Emperor… He looks surprisingly young…)
m930023.（ここからどうしようかねぇ、完全にしくじっちゃったし。\nせめてシズカと王子だけ:
(What do I do from here? We've completely botched this.
At the very least, I need to get Shizuka and the Prince out unscathed──)
m930023.（これじゃあ本当に死んじゃうよぉ！？）: (I'm really going to die here, aren't I?!)
m930023.（ふぃー、最近は夜も少し冷えますねぇ……）: (Phew, it's getting a little chilly at night lately……)
m930023.（まあよい、これで武家と朝廷の対立は決定的──）: (Very well. This makes the conflict between the military and the court absolute──)
m930023.（また面妖なのが現れたのぉ。\n王国の手の者か、それとも──）:
(Another odd one shows up.
Are they working for the Kingdom, or……)
m930023.（まったく、公家は根性なしが多くて嫌になるのぅ……）: (Honestly, the nobility are all spineless. It's disgusting……)
m930023.（よく言うよ……全部自分の仕込みのくせに）: (How dare you… You set all of this up yourself)
m930023.（キシシ、なんとも簡単な遊戯よなぁ……！）: (Hehehe, what a simple game this is……!)
m930023.（セイメイ大師匠直々の稽古、\n人死にが出る程とは聞いていたけれどぉ……！）:
(I heard Grand Master Seimei's personal training
could be deadly, but this is…!)
m930023.（喋っちゃ駄目よ、目を付けられるわ）: (Don't say a word. We don't want to draw attention to ourselves.)
m930023.（帝が儂の手にある以上、大義は常にこちらにある）: (As long as the Emperor is in my hands, the righteous cause is always on our side.)
m930023.（帝ではなくドウマン様だってさ……どっちが主なんだか）: (Not the Emperor, but "Lord Douman"… I wonder who the real master is here.)
m930023.（彼奴らを朝敵に認定し、\n逆賊の汚名を着せてやれば、\nこちらに寝返る者も増え:
(Once I brand them as enemies of the state
and slap the label of "rebel" on them,
more will surely come over to our side.)
m930023.（笑わないとやってられないこともあるのよ): (Sometimes, you just have to laugh to keep going.)
